measures.name: Public Measure RC - City of Le Mars General Obligation Bonds (Emergency Services Building)
measures.ballotLanguage: Shall the City of Le Mars, in Plymouth County, State of Iowa, enter into a loan agreement and issue general obligation bonds in an amount not exceeding $8,000,000 for the purpose of paying the cost, to that extent, of constructing, furnishing and equipping a municipal emergency services building?

measures.name: Public Measure RD - Hinton Community School District General Obligation Bonds
measures.ballotLanguage: Shall the Board of Directors of the Hinton Community School District in the County of Plymouth, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $8,600,000 to provide funds to remodel, repair, improve, furnish and equip its middle / high school facility, including site improvements?

notes: Supervisor seats: the Precinct 11 sample ballot shows all three supervisor contests (Districts 1, 3 and 4), so supervisors are elected countywide (at-large with district residency) rather than by district-only voting. Fredonia Township offices appear only on the Fredonia Township ballot style. Measure text is from the auditor's candidates-and-public-measures list; Le Mars measure appears only in Le Mars precincts, Hinton measure only in Hinton CSD precincts. Ryan Mitchell Weber is listed as 'NO PARTY' (nominated by petition).
